SparkVerb.ROOM SIZE: Simulated room size, from 4 m (small) to 50 m (very large)
SparkVerb.SHAPE: Delay distribution; 0-100%, from highest echo density to highest spectral mode density
SparkVerb.PRE DELAY: Delay before the wet signal is heard; 0-100 ms
SparkVerb.DENSITY: Reflection density; lower values sound more like distinct echoes
SparkVerb.LO DECAY: Low band decay ratio relative to main Decay; 0.1-10
SparkVerb.HI DECAY: High band decay ratio relative to main Decay; 0.1-10
SparkVerb.RATE: Relative modulation rate ratio per delay line; 0.25-4
SparkVerb.MODE: Modulation interpolation style; options in order: Dark (default), Lo-Fi, Bright
SparkVerb.DIFFUSION START: Delay until diffusion is heard; 1-10 ms
SparkVerb.ROLLOFF: Low-pass cutoff adjusting wet brightness; 2,000-20,000 Hz
SparkVerb.FREEZE: Holds the current decay indefinitely until disabled

Steiner Filter.RESONANCE: Emphasis at cutoff; 0-100%, high settings ring and self-oscillate
Steiner Filter.KEY TRACKING: Cutoff change relative to played note; 0-100%
Steiner Filter.MODE: Filter response; options in order: LP, BP, HP, HP raw, Notch, Allpass, Peak, Low Shelf, High Shelf, LP1, HP1, LP Notch, HP Notch, Morph, LP-BP-HP, LP-HP, Tilt, LP1-HP1 (default LP)
Steiner Filter.GAIN: Boost or cut for Peak and shelf modes; -24-24 dB
Steiner Filter.DEPTH: Far-side gain in LP Notch and HP Notch modes; -80-0 dB
Steiner Filter.MODEL: Response model; options in order: Ideal, Circuit (default)
Steiner Filter.COUPLING: Feedback-to-input resistance ratio in Circuit model; 0-100%
Steiner Filter.SOLVER: Saturation integration scheme; options in order: Linear, Linearly Implicit (default), Fixed Point, Newton

Studio Limiter.MARGIN: Maximum output level below zero dBFS; -5-0 dB
Studio Limiter.RELEASE: Time to stop limiting after falling below threshold; 10-500 ms

TS Overdrive.LOW FREQ: Lower corner of boosted and clipped band; 100-2,000 Hz
TS Overdrive.HIGH FREQ: Upper corner at minimum Drive, lowered up to tenfold as Drive rises; 10,000-100,000 Hz

Tape Echo.INTENSITY: Percentage of signal fed back into module; 0-200%
Tape Echo.MODE: Selects delay, delay plus reverb, or reverb only
Tape Echo.BASS: Boosts or cuts low frequencies of delayed signal; -10 to 10
Tape Echo.TREBLE: Boosts or cuts high frequencies of delayed signal; -10 to 10
Tape Echo.DELAY TIME: Delay time for each of three heads; 0.05-0.5 s

Thorus.MODE: Stereo style; options in order: Standard, Wide
Thorus.CROSSOVER: Split between pass-through and chorused signal; 20-5,000 Hz
Thorus.TRIM: Attenuates output to offset chorus level; -12-0 dB

Tilt.TILT: Gain per shelf band; negative boosts low and cuts high, positive reverses; -6-6 dB

Tone Stack.GAIN: Output boost after tone stack, unity to +20 dB; 0-100%

Track Delay.DELAY TIME: Time shift of input; 0-5 s, or bars/beats if tempo-synced

Tremolo.FREQ: LFO cycle rate, in Hz or bars/beats if synced; 0-20 Hz
Tremolo.DEPTH: Gain range swept, full range from -inf to 0 dBFS; 0-100%

UVI Filter.CUTOFF: Continuous low-pass to high-pass control; center is no filter, left low-pass, right high-pass
UVI Filter.MAPPING MODE: Cutoff mapping law; options in order: Standard (new patches), Legacy 1, Legacy 2

UVI Wide.WIDTH: Stereo spread; -100% gives mono, positive widens; -100-100%
UVI Wide.DELAY: Delay applied to one channel for wider image; -15-15 ms
UVI Wide.EXTRA WIDTH FREQ: High-shelf frequency on side channel; 2,000-20,000 Hz
UVI Wide.EXTRA WIDTH GAIN: High-shelf gain on side channel; -15-15 dB

VCF-20.HP/LP MORPH: Balance between high- and low-pass filters; 0-100%
VCF-20.KEY TRACKING: Cutoff change relative to active note; 0-100%

VCF-20 Dual.KEY TRACKING: Cutoff change relative to active note; 0-100%

VCF-4023.KEY TRACKING: Cutoff change relative to active note; 0-100%
Saturation of OTA stage, on by default
Saturation of op-amp stage, on by default
VCF-4023.ALT. OUTPUT: Takes signal from other tap of filter chain; off by default

Velvet Delay.SHAPE: Echo shape; options in order: Ramp (default), Uniform, Exp, Ramp down, Parabolic, Inv. Parabolic, Parametric
Velvet Delay.CURVE: Bends Parametric shape concave or convex; -100-100%, no effect on other shapes

Vowel Filter.MODE: Filter style; options in order: LP2, BP2, HP2
Vowel Filter.FORMANT: Shifts formant frequencies higher or lower; -100-100%

Vowels.FORMANT: Shifts formant frequencies higher or lower; -100-100%
Vowels.MODE: Filter style; options in order: LP, BP, HP

WahWah.WAH: Filter frequency, often modulated or pedal-controlled; 0-100%
WahWah.MODEL: Pedal model with own sweep and resonance; options in order: Default, Cry, CryB, CryC, Vox, VoxM, CryBassHigh

Wave Shaper.INPUT GAIN: Gain into module before shaping; -40-40 dB
Wave Shaper.PRE FREQ: Low-pass frequency applied before waveshaping; 20-22,000 Hz
Wave Shaper.WAVE SHAPE: Shape chosen from menu of waveforms
Wave Shaper.AMOUNT: Shape character; 0-100%, active for sine, Fold-back, tanh, atan, HyperSine, Asym and Exp
Wave Shaper.KNEE: Shape transition; -10 to 10, active for tanh, atan, Damped sat and Exp
Wave Shaper.POST FREQ: High-pass frequency applied after waveshaping; 2-20,000 Hz
Wave Shaper.MIX: Balance between dry and shaped signal; 0-100%

Wavefolder.TIMBRE: Gain into folding circuit, half to ten times input; 0-100%, controls added harmonics
Wavefolder.SYMM: Offset before folding, adding even harmonics; 0-100%

Xpander Filter.MODE: Filter shape from 37 options; types LP, HP, BP, AP, PK, T, with order number indicating slope
Xpander Filter.KEY TRACKING: Cutoff change relative to played note; 0-100%
Xpander Filter.ALGORITHM: Solver; options in order: Mode I (classic constant-Q), Mode II (modern zero-delay)
Xpander Filter.TYPE: Overdrive style; options in order: Soft Saturation, Hard Clip, Linear
Xpander Filter.THICKNESS: Overdrives low frequencies to offset DC gain drop; 0-100%
